categorical_one_hot_policy: Excluded from first model for a small transparent numeric baseline; source categorical novelty signals remain available in the v2 matrix.

amount.reason_for_inclusion: Direct transaction magnitude is observable at transaction time.
amount.transformation: candidate matrix numeric value in synthetic INR units

channel_novelty_before.missing_value_behavior: 0.0 source fallback for first user row

day_of_week.reason_for_inclusion: Captures coarse calendar context without identifiers.
day_of_week.transformation: UTC weekday encoded as 0 through 6 numeric value

merchant_novelty_before.missing_value_behavior: 0.0 source fallback for first user row

time_since_previous_transaction_seconds.missing_value_behavior: training median plus explicit missing indicator
time_since_previous_transaction_seconds.transformation: prior-only elapsed time since the previous user transaction

time_since_previous_transaction_seconds_.missing_value_behavior: 0.0 or 1.0 as supplied by v2 feature artifact
time_since_previous_transaction_seconds_.reason_for_inclusion: Prevents imputation from hiding limited history.
time_since_previous_transaction_seconds_.transformation: explicit indicator for unavailable previous transaction

transaction_hour.reason_for_inclusion: Supports research analysis of timing deviation.
transaction_hour.transformation: UTC hour encoded as 0 through 23 numeric value

user_historical_average_amount_before.missing_value_behavior: training median if missing; source first-row fallback is 0.00

user_historical_category_frequency_befor.reason_for_inclusion: Represents prior category familiarity without using the label.
user_historical_category_frequency_befor.transformation: prior-only frequency of the current category for the user

user_historical_transaction_count_before.reason_for_inclusion: Provides behavioral-history depth and uncertainty context.
user_historical_transaction_count_before.transformation: prior-only count from the existing v2 feature artifact

user_relative_amount_deviation.reason_for_inclusion: Makes the amount explanation user-relative and inspectable.

user_relative_time_deviation.source_column: transaction_hour and prior user transaction hours
user_relative_time_deviation.transformation: prior-only circular-hour distance from user prior average

missing_value_policy: Use train-only medians for missing model values; retain explicit previous-transaction missing indicator.
target_policy: target_scenario_label is retained only in offline score outputs and evaluation; never used for fitting, thresholds, or explanations.
temporal_policy: Existing v2 train/validation/test files are preserved; model fit uses train only and current rows remain excluded from prior history.
